E_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.description: The application, its service, plugin or device is absent, unreachable, unlicensed or speaks another protocol; nothing was dispatched.

E_BUSY.description: The application main thread or the target is busy; nothing was dispatched; retry after a short wait.

E_HUMAN_REQUIRED.description: A person must act first: a dialog, a sign-in or licence prompt, an approval or a physical step. Relay details.action, wait, then run details.resume.

E_NATIVE_FAILURE.description: The application rejected the operation and nothing lasting remained; read the receipt.

E_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.description: The operation may have run and its result could not be established; query the operation and read back the target before anything else.

E_PARTIAL.description: Some requested stages or items took effect and others did not; read the receipt; never resend the whole request.

E_PROTOCOL.description: The backend replied with something the CLI cannot read; read details.dispatch_state before any further write.

E_UNSUPPORTED.description: A valid request this build, mode or session cannot carry out; choose another capability.

E_VERIFY_FAILED.description: The operation took effect and a required read-back check failed.

E_VERIFY_INCOMPLETE.description: The operation took effect and a required read-back check could not be completed.

A configuration refusal retains unqualified_report_observation with its consumed file hashes; it does not qualify execution or update a previous receipt.
pcb_check.native_file_integrity: Live native and SDK readback bind all four output roles to the requested board paths, reject reparse points, and consume at most 32 MiB per regular file. Hashes describe the captured bytes and device/inode file identity. All roles are recaptured after parsing; a changed output refuses. This is not an atomic multi-file database snapshot.

Its complete flag covers these getters only, not complete object identity or DRC verification. The finite Layer1 pin-to-own-Top-placement matcher additionally needs independent object UIDs/types, real Layer1 pad material and native placement-outline geometry. PlacementOutline has no Position getter: its observed rectangle minimum is a geometry-derived correspondence anchor, never a fabricated Position observation. No annular124460/4.9 normalization is enabled; field-specific storage semantics are still unproven, and missing/duplicate unit or value headers refuse configuration binding.

All ten declared paths, including the five lifecycle logs, are observed for byte changes; other native side effects remain unclassified and a declared path does not prove a fresh or complete report.

This does not add a native hazard mapping, count opens, verify native completion or establish rule applicability. Use checks result --native-files for explicitly historical hash-bound parsing; a successful historical parse never updates an older check or operation receipt.
pcb_check.rule_execution_scope: source.coverage.rule_execution_verification correlates the observed 151.0 Chinese PARTCOVERLAYER/VIACOVERLAYER report markers with their settings.
